selector.rationale: Patient presents with worsening shortness of breath, NYHA class IV symptoms, elevated jugular venous pressure, bilateral lung crackles, and a prominent S3, all of which are indicative of heart failure. The patient's history of ischemic cardiomyopathy and decreased ejection fraction also support this diagnosis.
